item.title: JUNIOR REPORTER – WHAT’S ON DUBAI - Motivate Media Group
item.description: What’s On is the UAE and Saudi Arabia’s go-to brand for entertainment and lifestyle. We’re eaters, adventurers, explorers and storytellers. Whether it's uncovering a hidden gem, reviewing a new restaurant, or interviewing a celebrity, we bring our expertise, enthusiasm and voice to every story that’s truly worth your time.
